verdict.rationale: There is no dedicated data-export feature. You can pull transfer history and events through paginated List Transfers and List Events APIs, and move assets off-platform by fiat wire/CUBIX withdrawal or on-chain stablecoin redemption, which together approximate exporting data and leaving. missing for 10: documented bulk or full-account data export, explicit open export formats (e.g., CSV/JSON dumps), account closure/offboarding process, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent corroboration.
